authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Regional lexical-family membership only: the existing user-approved ḍobū buffalo family was created from independently attested Mewari ḍobū and ḍɔbī buffalo (original family proposal 247). The selected Bhil/Bareli ḍubi/ḍobi/ḍubo/ḍobu/ḍuba-type buffalo responses fit this regional stem and sense. The original family itself has both u- and i-endings; preserve survey vowels, dental/retroflex notation and the single aspirated ḍɦubi spelling as qualifications. The head is an attested representative, not a reconstructed ancestor; ultimate etymology and regional transmission remain unresolved. Extra ḍobaḍ/ḍobeḍ/ḍobar/ḍobaṛi extensions are excluded from this batch. Exact response: ḍubi.
